_comment: Hand-maintained inputs to scripts/generate-manifest.mjs. Everything else in tools.json is read from the Playground catalogue.

property-custom._source: Index.vue estimatedCallCost: builderTotalCost = 1 + sum of selected add-on costs

property-custom.name: with
property-custom.playground_hint: Comma-separated add-on slugs (see tokens.addons), or all. The Playground builds this with its add-on picker rather than a declared param.

idempotency_key._source: thor DeveloperController playground proxy: 'listing-address' => ['method' => 'POST', 'idempotent' => true] sends a fresh UUID Idempotency-Key per call; loki's schema says the route requires one

exclusion_notes.property-sales: adminOnly in the Playground (hidden from customers). Excluded by the generic rule; requester confirmation pending as of 2026-09-17. To include, add the id to include_admin_only.

static_tools.name: start_homedata_signup
static_tools.purpose: Walks a user without an API key through getting one. Makes no API call.
static_tools.stub_description: Start a Homedata signup: returns the signup link and the steps to get an API key for UK property data. Makes no API call.

static_tools.name: check_homedata_api_key
static_tools.purpose: Reports whether HOMEDATA_API_KEY is set and active. TARGET contract: must not spend tokens. As of 0.4.0 it calls /address/find/ (2 tokens); T2 decides how to meet the contract.
static_tools.stub_description: Check whether a Homedata API key is configured for this server and what to do next if it is not.
